# Ezekiel 9 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 9:6 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Old-man, young-man and-virgin, and-children and-women, you-shall-kill to-destruction; but-upon every man who-has upon-him the-mark, do-not-draw-near. And-from-My-sanctuary you-shall-begin." And-they-began with-the-men, the-elders, who [were] before the-house. |
| LOGOS | Kill old men outright, young men and maidens, little children and women, but touch no one on whom is the mark. And begin at My sanctuary." So they began with the elders who were before the house. |
| PNEUMA | Slaughter the old, the young, the women, and the children — but don't touch anyone with the mark. Start right here at My Temple." So they began with the elders standing in front of the Temple. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 9:10 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-I also — My-eye shall-not-spare, and-I-will-not-have-pity; their-way upon-their-head I-have-put." |
| LOGOS | As for Me, My eye will not spare, nor will I have pity; I will bring their deeds upon their heads." |
| PNEUMA | So I will not spare them. I will not show pity. I will bring the consequences of their actions down on their own heads." |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 9:11 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-behold, the-man clothed-in the-linen, who [had] the-case-of-ink at-his-waist, brought-back word, saying, "I-have-done as all-that You-commanded-me." |
| LOGOS | And behold, the man clothed in linen, with the writing case at his waist, brought back word, saying, "I have done as You commanded me." |
| PNEUMA | Then the man in linen with the writing kit returned and reported, "I have done everything You commanded." |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 9:7 (overlap: 5%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-He-said to-them, "Defile the-house and-fill the-courts [with]-the-slain. Go-out!" And-they-went-out and-struck in-the-city. |
| LOGOS | Then He said to them, "Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain. Go out." So they went out and struck in the city. |
| PNEUMA | "Defile the Temple!" He ordered. "Fill the courtyards with corpses! Go!" So they went out and began killing throughout the city. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 9:5 (overlap: 5%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-to-the-others He-said in-my-hearing, "Pass through the-city after-him and-strike. Let-not your-eye spare, and-do-not-have-pity. |
| LOGOS | And to the others He said in my hearing, "Pass through the city after him, and strike. Your eye shall not spare, and you shall show no pity. |
| PNEUMA | Then I heard Him tell the others, "Follow him through the city and kill everyone without the mark. Show no mercy and no pity. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 9:9 (overlap: 6%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-He-said to-me, "The-iniquity-of the-house-of Israel and-Judah [is] great, exceedingly, exceedingly, and-the-land is-filled [with]-blood, and-the-city is-full-of perversion; for they-say, 'YHWH has-forsaken the-land, and-YHWH does-not-see.' |
| LOGOS | Then He said to me, "The guilt of the house of Israel and Judah is exceedingly great. The land is full of blood, and the city full of injustice. For they say, 'The LORD has forsaken the land, and the LORD does not see.' |
| PNEUMA | He answered, "The sin of Israel and Judah is immense — beyond measure. The land is soaked in blood, and the city is full of injustice. They say to themselves, 'The LORD has abandoned this land. The LORD doesn't see what we do.' |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.
